title: A fluorine doped carbon aerogel prepared from the spent cathode carbon of aluminum electrolysis towards electrocatalytic synthesis of H2O2
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01505C, Paper
Zhaoxu Li, Yu Liu, Junlang Zhang, Chao Yang, Xintai Su, Chenyuan Zhu, Yongjun Jiang, Wenxin Zhao, Bo Zeng, Chenxi Zhao, Xueli Huang, Hongtao Xie, Yizhao Li
Fluorine doped carbon aerogels were prepared from spent cathode carbon in aluminum electrolysis and were used for electrocatalytic synthesis of H2O2.
